name: v3.11.0
body:
### Added
- **Books, manga and audiobooks for programs that drive Anki Miner (`--api`, see API.md).** New commands: `inspect`, `extract`, `transcribe`, `video-ocr`, `retime`, `sync` and `ocr`.
- **Mine numbers with their counters (Settings -> Word Filters -> Numbers).** Off by default; 4人 makes one card, read よにん.
- **Ignore suspended cards (Settings -> Word Filters -> Excluded Decks).**

### Changed
- **Japanese mines common kana-only words (もう, まだ, この, こと).** Skip hiragana-only words (Settings -> Word Filters -> Script Type) keeps them off cards.
- **Japanese mines the kana spelling of words usually written in kanji (わたし, じっと, おなか).**
- **Japanese mines a word and its particle as one card (本当に, 誰も, 一人で).**
- **Japanese mines everyday place names (日本, 東京, パリ).**
- **Romanian verb cards front the citation infinitive (`a vorbi`).**

### Fixed
- **AV1 videos play in the Linux AppImage and .deb preview (#140).**
- **Definitions follow each note type's own spacing, and Kiku's Glossary Split pages keep their styling.** Restyle existing cards: Utilities -> Card Backfill -> Styling.
- **Japanese cards take the everyday reading of 私, 明日, 何 and 日本語.**
- **日本人, アメリカ人 and 日本酒 are mined.**
- **A Japanese verb before 〜そう cards as the verb (落ちそう -> 落ちる).**
- **A word restarted after an ellipsis is mined (……待って -> 待つ).**
- **The bold on a Japanese card's sentence covers auxiliaries and suffixes (教えてくれた, 動きそう, 温かさ).**
- **Romanian cards front the dictionary form (`cheile` -> `cheie`, `vorbești` -> `vorbi`).**
- **Romanian lone caption letters no longer become cards, and mis-encoded `ã`, `º`, `þ` read as `ă`, `ș`, `ț`.**
- **`--api setup` no longer downloads an installed frequency list again.**

name: v3.10.1
body:
### Fixed
- **"Align captions to audio" no longer moves YouTube captions to the wrong place (Settings -> YouTube) (#137).** Automatic captions are left as fetched.
- **Clips from YouTube's automatic captions no longer run into the next line (#137).**
- **Romaji lines under Japanese captions no longer reach the card's sentence.**
- **A known 〜する verb now covers its 〜される, 〜すべき and 〜せない forms.** With 愛する known, 愛される and 愛せない are no longer mined.
- **The Activity Log says why a YouTube link cannot be mined (Video -> YouTube).**

name: v3.10.0
body:
### Added
- **Whole mining history, known-words growth and frequency coverage by rank band (Analytics).**
- **Open or delete a past run's cards (Analytics -> Mining History).**
- **Browse, search and remove known words (Settings -> Word Filters -> Manage Known Words…).**
- **Import known words from Kindle, Lute and LWT (Manage Known Words… -> Import…).**
- **Export words to CSV (Manage Known Words…, a run's View details).**
- **Daily backups (Settings -> General -> Restore a backup…).**
- **Pick the clearest sentence for each word (Settings -> Sentences).**
- **Skip openings, endings and signs (Settings -> Sentences).**
- **Even out audio volume (Settings -> Card Media).** Clips no longer start or end with a click.
- **Crop manga pictures to the speech bubble (Settings -> Card Media).**
- **Count a word as known only after its card has been reviewed (Settings -> Word Filters).** Mining still skips words that have a card.
- **Sync Anki after mining (Settings -> Cards & Anki).**
- **`{series}`, `{episode}` and `{volume}` in card tags (Settings -> Cards & Anki).** `mined::{series}::{episode}` gives `mined::Frieren::03`.
- **AnkiConnect API key support.** Add the key to the address in Settings -> Cards & Anki: `http://127.0.0.1:8765/?key=YOUR_KEY`.
- **Fetch web articles into Reading -> Text.**
- **PDF books (Reading -> Novels).** A scanned PDF with no text layer is refused.
- **A book's own furigana on the card.**
- **Translation subtitles picked automatically (Video -> Single, Batch, Deck Builder).**
- **Choose a card's dictionary in the Word Curator.**
- **Image subtitles in Video OCR (Utilities -> Video OCR).** Blu-ray `.sup`, DVD `.sub` + `.idx`, or an image track inside a video.
- **StarDict dictionaries and CSV/TSV word lists (Settings -> Dictionaries -> Add dictionary…).**
- **FreeDict dictionaries for Lithuanian, Slovenian, Arabic, Croatian and Hungarian (Tools -> Download Recommended Resources…).**
- **Wikimedia Commons recordings and an Edge voice for every language (Settings -> Word Audio).**
- **`.lrc` lyrics work as subtitles.** Retime does not take them.
- **Sync a shelf of audiobooks in one run (Utilities -> Audiobook Sync -> Folder).**
- **A sync report for each audiobook (Utilities -> Audiobook Sync).** Subtitle and narration coverage, graded A to D.
- **Saved Whisper transcripts (Utilities -> Generate, Audiobook Sync).** A second run on the same file skips transcription.

### Changed
- **The Definition and Glossary fields hold definitions only.** Rebuild older cards: Utilities -> Card Backfill, Definitions and Glossary checked, Overwrite existing values on.
- **Restyle cards… is now the Styling option in Card Backfill (Utilities -> Card Backfill).**
- **New installs pick the clearest sentence, skip openings and endings, even out volume and crop manga pictures.** Existing installs keep their settings.
- **One card per sentence moves a word to another line (Settings -> Sentences).** It used to skip the word.
- **Generate splits long Whisper lines at sentence ends (Utilities -> Generate).**
- **Condense keeps pauses shorter than one second between lines.**
- **Condense prefers the full dialogue track over a Signs & Songs track.**
- **EPUB copyright, contents and index pages are no longer mined.**
- **The Activity Log warns when a file looks like another language.**
- **Video OCR leaves out lines with none of the mining language's letters.**
- **The Opus option warns that AnkiMobile cannot play it (Settings -> Card Media).**

### Removed
- **Tag chips, their hover descriptions and the forms row on mined cards.**

### Fixed
- **The Linux app keeps its video preview when started from its own menu entry or a packager's wrapper.**
- **Karaoke and animated sign frames count as one subtitle line.**
- **Audiobook Sync times passages read out of book order.**
- **Anki started by Anki Miner no longer writes into the terminal Anki Miner was started from.**

name: v3.9.0
body:
### Added
- **The interface comes in every mining language (Settings -> General -> Interface language).** Twenty-two new ones; Arabic, Persian and Hebrew run right to left.
- **Check how much of a book or manga you can read (Utilities -> Readability).** EPUB and .txt books, mokuro volumes, or a folder of them.
- **Manga OCR and Video OCR read every mining language except Hebrew, Vietnamese and Cantonese (Utilities -> Manga OCR, Video OCR).**

### Changed
- **Everyday words such as 魔王, 安堵 and 口元 are no longer treated as names.**
- **思わず, 実は, 常に, くだらない and similar words are mined whole.**
- **Plain 知らせる, 済ませる and 間に合わせる are mined as themselves.**
- **彼の方が強い no longer makes a card for 彼の方 ("that person").**
- **Card pictures are at most 720 pixels high.**
- **Sentence audio is mono, and new installs cut it at 96 kbps.**
- **The Source field leaves out the release group and the resolution.** `[SubsPlease] Frieren - 01 (1080p)` now reads `Frieren - 01`.
- **Japanese, Chinese and Cantonese subtitles drop speaker names, (notes), [sound effects], ♪ and dialogue dashes on new installs (Settings -> Sentences).**
- **New installs bold the mined word, create cards in order of appearance and open Anki at startup.** Existing installs keep their settings.
- **The subtitle offset moves in 0.1 second steps (Single, Batch, Deck Builder, Batch Edit).**
- **Transcription on the CPU uses about one thread per core, up to 8.**

### Fixed
- **The video preview no longer covers its subtitle strip and slider in a short window (Word Curator, subtitle viewer).**
- **The Undo button's card count and the playlist picker's Add button follow the interface language's plural forms.**
- **Meanings no longer run together on Senren cards ("to waveto shaketo swing").** Restyle existing cards: Utilities -> Card Backfill -> Restyle cards…
- **A one-file Utilities run shows how far through the file it is.**
- **Video OCR keeps a line with an ellipsis as one subtitle.** Run Video OCR again to rebuild an older .srt.

name: v3.8.0
body:
### Added
- **Read burned-in subtitles from a video (Utilities -> Video OCR).** Writes a timed .srt; Japanese only, not in the Intel Mac app.
- **Dictionary updates.** Dictionaries, frequency lists and pitch sources that publish updates refresh weekly at startup, or from Tools -> Update Dictionaries Now.
- **Mine Bilibili and other video sites.** Video -> YouTube takes their links, multi-part videos and collections included.
- **Save the subtitle and audio tracks inside a video (Utilities -> Tracks).**
- **See why a word wasn't mined.** The Activity Log lists each skipped word, its reason, and the setting that would mine it.
- **Subtitles pair with videos that don't share their name.** Language tags, episode numbers and `Subs` folders count in Video -> Single, Audiobooks and Condense.
- **Open Anki when Anki Miner starts (Settings -> Cards & Anki).**
- **System Health checks the mining language's engine.**

### Changed
- **Max Sentence Characters is kept per mining language (Settings -> Sentences).**
- **Merging incomplete subtitle lines no longer loses both spellings of a word.**
- **Reading: the occurrence floor and the Word Curator's Occurrences column count each card's own spelling.**
- **Korean words written only in Hanja count as known once their card is in Anki.** Later episodes in a batch skip them too.
- **Reading -> Manga mines `.mokuro` volumes in every mining language.**
- **Batch picks the subtitle tagged with your mining language** when two in a folder share an episode number.
- **Audiobook Sync rarely times audio against the wrong part of a book (Utilities -> Audiobook Sync).**
- **Deck Filter matches word lists on the deck's own spellings.** Chinese and Cantonese notes are read and ranked by pinyin and Jyutping.
- **A Settings page for the Utilities tab's tools (Settings -> Utilities).**
- **Text-to-speech offers only the voices the mining language has (Settings -> Card Media).** The Read aloud row is now called Text-to-speech.
- **Mining languages go by their own names.**
- **Settings headings stand out.** Resource lists fill the page, and download buttons hide once installed.
- **Numbers use a decimal point everywhere.**

### Removed
- **The Jisho online dictionary (Settings -> Dictionaries).** Definitions come only from installed dictionaries.
- **The low-contrast note under the theme gallery** (Settings -> General).

### Fixed
- **Arabic, Persian and Hebrew read right to left in tables.** Word Curator, Manage Known Words, Card Backfill and Deck Filter.
- **Screens, messages and logs follow the mining language instead of assuming Japanese.**
- **A language pack that installs but still can't load leaves the mining language as it was.**
- **The setup wizard recovers when AnkiConnect never answers, the address is blank, or a language-pack download fails.**
- **Settings search no longer jumps to a control you cannot see.** Confirmations and keyboard focus stay in the dialog in use.
- **Login and cookie errors name the real setting.** Arrow keys on Cookies from browser no longer open the file picker.
- **Re-import finds a downloaded Wiktionary (wty) dictionary's saved copy.** A bundle's disabled word list no longer half-installs.
- **Core 2k/6k decks pick the right sentence field (Reading -> Anki Deck).**
- **A missing book or manga volume is named as gone (Reading -> Manga, Novels).**
- **The Word Curator's toolbar fits a 1024px screen in every language.** Reset columns and tag-chip spacing are corrected.
- **Readability no longer writes to the known-words file, and says when a source didn't load (Utilities -> Readability).**
- **Readability keeps zh-HK and zh-Hant subtitles when mining Cantonese (Utilities -> Readability).**
- **Audio packs play Chinese and Cantonese words that have two readings.**
- **French speaker labels with two no-break spaces before the colon are stripped again.**
- **Chinese and Cantonese cards fill the Language field** even when the sentence gets no script tag.
- **A field named POS maps to part of speech again.**
- **Cantonese transcription on the small Whisper model stops with a message naming large-v3.**
- **Utilities keep the values you saved.** Download's language expressions and Condense's millisecond offset.
- **Status-bar badges stay in view.**
- **Theme previews fill their tiles** on scaled displays and under Zoom.
- **Batch counts use each language's plurals.**
- **Analytics catches a run that finishes mid-refresh.**
- **Mining the same `run_id` again starts clean (`--api`).** Input files saved with a UTF-8 BOM are read too.

name: v3.7.0
body:
### Added
- **Update in place on Windows and the AppImage.** Update now downloads and checks the new version, and Restart now installs it.
- **The AppImage carries update information.** AppImageUpdate, Gear Lever and other AppImage managers can update it.
- **A Language field (Settings -> Cards & Anki).** Map it and each card stores its language tag, such as ja, zh-Hans or de.
- **Anki Miner Note is recognised in every mining language (Settings -> Cards & Anki -> Fill in automatically).**
- **More for programs that drive Anki Miner (`--api`).** New commands `render`, `media`, `fetch`, `settings-import` and `setup`, and a dry run for `mine`.

### Changed
- **The whitelist now also keeps names, interjections, kana-only words and dictionary compounds (Settings -> Word Filters).**
- **Max Sentence Duration and Max Sentence Characters measure the full sentence when "Mine full sentences across subtitle lines" is on (Settings -> Sentences).**
- **i+1 no longer gives a card a sentence that holds only another spelling of its word.**
- **With i+1 on, merging a sentence across subtitle lines no longer adds a second unknown word.**
- **Words that differ only by case or character set make one card per run** (Essen and essen, 頭髮 and 头发).
- **Batch in season mode no longer cards a word an earlier episode of the run just added.**
- **Word list entries in half-width katakana or kanji variants now match mined words** (ｺｰﾋｰ, 𠮟る).
- **French sentences keep their no-break spaces,** so ? ! : ; and » no longer start a new line on the card.
- **Korean words written only in Hanja show their hangul on the card front** when the dictionary gives it (學校 -> 학교).
- **Pitch position fields hold the downstep number** for pitch dictionaries that list high/low patterns (LHHL becomes 3).
- **German nouns used only in the plural show "die (Pl.)" in the Gender field.**
- **Deck Builder leaves out words no installed dictionary defines.** A build needs an offline dictionary.
- **The setup wizard no longer assumes Lapis for Japanese.**
- **Pinyin and Jyutping tone colours can follow the note type's theme.**
- **API runs (`--api mine`) no longer apply One card per sentence or i+1.**
- **The Thai, Chinese, Vietnamese and Cantonese frequency lists download from a separate repository.** Older versions lose these downloads; installed lists keep working.

### Fixed
- **View details no longer counts filtered words as known in Comprehension.**
- **Reading -> Anki Deck: the Word Curator shows the card's line under its picture.**
- **Fill in automatically maps Hebrew part of speech and Thai Paiboon readings.**
- **Indonesian affixes no longer break after a hyphen.**
- **Dictionary entries no longer show " | " between meanings; Wiktionary tags show as chips.** Restyle existing cards: Utilities -> Card Backfill -> Restyle cards…

name: v3.6.0
body:
### Added
- **Mine a sentence-card deck already in Anki (Reading -> Anki Deck, #131).** New cards reuse each card's audio, picture and translation.
- **Readability report for a subtitle file or folder (Utilities -> Readability, #132).** Shows the share of known words, new words and i+1 lines.

### Changed
- **Re-import occurrence-based frequency lists:** Settings -> Frequency -> More -> Reimport All. A word listed twice now ranks by its larger count.
- **Japanese verb and adjective readings come from the line that used them** (言う reads いう, not ゆう).
- **Korean mines the words after a contracted verb** (엄마 in 빨리 가 엄마가 기다려).
- **Eight more languages drop the English line of a bilingual cue,** including Russian, Hebrew, Arabic and Thai.
- **A straight quote or Hebrew geresh no longer joins sentences in Hebrew, Arabic, Persian and Thai.**
- **Sound captions wrapped over two lines are removed like one-line ones.**
- **Run progress shows once, in the pinned bar.** The result line sits under the inputs, with View details and Show in Anki.
- **Mining screens explain a refusal or failure in the banner at the top.**
- **A four-page setup wizard: Language, Dictionary, Anki, Ready.** Any note type works once its fields are mapped.
- **Settings-wide Export, Import and Reset moved to Manage profiles….** Resource Export and Import are in the Tools menu.
- **Fewer settings,** such as one Clip length, one subtitle clean-up box and one speech-to-text download.
- **One "Fill in automatically" button (Settings -> Cards & Anki),** replacing Preset, Apply and Auto-Map.
- **The Word Curator opens on the first word, with fewer columns for a new user.**
- **Queues show their tools only when they can act.** Batch rows are one line each.
- **One field for a file or a folder (Reading -> Manga, Reading -> Novels).**
- **Mine adds the picked audio and subtitle pair (Audiobooks).**
- **"Mine Episode" and "Mine Queue" (Video -> Single, Video -> Batch).**
- **A lighter window frame.** The title row is gone; profile and theme menus sit at the end of the tab row.
- **System Health in the Tools menu.**
- **New installs hide Deck Filter and Download (Settings -> General).** Existing installs keep every tool.
- **Manga OCR models move into the data folder (Utilities -> Manga OCR).** They download once more after updating.

### Removed
- **"Finish current, then stop" on running queues.** Press Pause, then Cancel.
- **Batch's Retry Failed button.** Select the failed rows, then Retry selected.
- **The YouTube screen's "Align captions to audio" box.** It stays in Settings -> YouTube.
- **The Analytics Refresh button.** Analytics refreshes after each run.
- **Program-path fields for yt-dlp and mokuro, and Max Parallel Workers.**

### Fixed
- **AnkiConnect calls no longer fail at random.**
- **The AppImage and .deb start on X11 desktops without libxcb-cursor.**
- **Each mining language keeps its own data across a switch or settings import.** Dictionaries, statistics, Undo and word-audio caches stay with their language.
- **Reset to defaults gives a non-Japanese language its own defaults (Manage profiles…).**
- **Queue runs see words marked known mid-run and cards removed by Undo.**
- **Result lines count the work of failed or cancelled items.**
- **A second window always warns that Anki Miner is already running.**
- **The Word Curator shows the reading the card gets** and no longer freezes on a season-sized list.
- **`\h` in ASS subtitles is a space, and SAMI or WebVTT files with a byte-order mark open.**
- **Episode pairing ignores tags such as AAC2.0, Hi10P and 1080p60.**
- **Mostly-UTF-8 Japanese text files are no longer garbled (Reading).**
- **Ruby novels without a title block keep their opening paragraphs (Reading -> Novels).**
- **A Utilities tool cannot start a second run while it scans a folder.**
- **Audiobook Sync aligns files that start far into the book.**
- **Generated subtitles and condensed audio get normal file permissions again.**
- **Settings search shows six results before it scrolls.**
- **Windows and dialogs no longer cut off buttons at their smallest size.**
- **English counts use plural forms** ("1 card", "2 cards").
- **Restart now and Create Desktop Shortcut start the running copy,** not another install on PATH.
- **`--api mine` accepts a video whose container reports no duration.**

name: v3.5.0
body:
### Added
- **Turkish, Indonesian, Thai, Slovenian, Arabic, Russian, Persian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Cantonese and Hebrew mining (Settings -> Mining Language).**
- **Right-to-left text for Arabic, Persian and Hebrew, on cards and in the app.**
- **Wiktionary dictionaries and frequency lists for the new languages (setup wizard).**
- **Word audio from Microsoft Edge voices (Settings -> Word Audio -> Add audio source).** Default for Slovenian and Persian.
- **Command-line mining for other programs (`anki-miner mine`, `AnkiMiner --api mine`).** See CLI.md and API.md.
- **Export and import a language's resources as one file (Settings -> Export / Import -> Resources).**
- **Rebindable keyboard shortcuts (Settings -> Keyboard).** Mark known moves from K to D.
- **A mining-language page in the setup wizard.**
- **A Position column in the Word Curator**, with each word's timestamp or page.
- **SAMI (`.smi`) subtitles in every language.**
- **Subtitles-only downloads (Utilities -> Download).**
- **Jiten frequency list for Japanese, and a frequency list for Chinese (Tools -> Download Recommended Resources).**
- **A choice of which Utilities tools to show (Settings -> General).**
- **Card Backfill fills each language's own card fields (Utilities -> Card Backfill),** such as Pinyin and Jyutping.
- **Character Set "As written", now the Chinese default (Settings -> Mining Language).**

### Changed
- **Re-import frequency lists and KRDICT installed under 3.4.0:** Settings -> Frequency or Dictionaries -> More -> Reimport All.
- **Card fronts in the Wiktionary languages come from the dictionary's headwords.** Words carded under 3.4.0 can return with a new front; a few drop out.
- **Card fronts change in several languages,** including English plural-only nouns, Catalan feminine nouns and Hungarian potential verbs.
- **Definitions open on the sense for the word's part of speech.**
- **Known-word matching ignores a deck front's trailing note** (`der Hund, -e`, `bank (river)`).
- **A word with no definition of its own, only pointers to missing entries, now counts as having none.**
- **Occurrence counts include every spelling a card covers.**
- **Settings pages reorganised.** Filtering splits into Word Filters and Sentences, Audio becomes Word Audio, and Appearance & Language becomes General.
- **One Sentence Rule choice replaces the Deduplicate by Sentence and i+1 checkboxes (Settings -> Word Filters).**
- **Animated screenshots take a Size preset (Settings -> Card Media).**
- **Deck Builder moved under Video.** Tab shortcuts are now Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+6.
- **Manga OCR setup moved to Utilities -> Manga OCR.**
- **A `.txt` book over 32 MB mines in parts (Reading -> Novels).**
- **Chinese mines conjunctions, prepositions and everyday words its tokenizer mis-tagged** (因为, 在, 一起, 看吧).
- **Chinese readings follow the installed dictionary, and definitions lead with the word's meaning** rather than a surname or cross-reference.
- **Chinese and Korean drop the other-language line of a bilingual cue.**
- **Tone colours are readable on white and night-mode cards.**

### Removed
- **The "Use system file dialogs" toggle.** Native dialogs are always used.
- **The "Text size" control.** Zoom is the one size control.
- **The sentence-length filter's Enable box.** A limit above 0 turns the filter on.
- **Tools -> Restyle Mined Cards,** now Utilities -> Card Backfill -> Restyle cards.
- **The Swedish Plural card field.**

### Fixed
- **Screenshots and audio reach Anki much faster, and big batches no longer lose them.**
- **Check for Updates and the yt-dlp install work on macOS.** Install this release from the release page: 3.4.0 cannot update itself on a Mac.
- **Recommended resources for non-Japanese languages are used after download.** Add a dictionary downloaded under 3.4.0 again.
- **The setup wizard and System Health no longer call a dictionary for another language ready.**
- **YouTube accepts every caption code a language lists** (`zh-TW`, `en-GB`, `pt-BR`).
- **Word lists, known-words files and subtitles decode in more encodings** (GB18030, Big5, UTF-16).
- **Utilities -> Retime no longer corrupts a GB18030 or Big5 subtitle.**
- **Chinese readings, script conversion and sentence splitting are corrected** (这儿, 显著, curly quotes).
- **Manage Known Words -> Remove deletes a row stored in the other script.**
- **A `.txt` novel is no longer read as Aozora Bunko** by mistake.
- **Hard-wrapped `.txt` novels read as paragraphs.**
- **Reading keeps a dialogue tag, an ordinal date or an abbreviation in its sentence.**
- **A new mining language no longer inherits the Japanese frequency band.**
- **Japanese-only rows and wording no longer show for other mining languages.**
- **Languages without readings no longer warn that words "have more than one reading".**
- **Glossary is filled for words found by a fallback lookup,** in mining and Card Backfill.
- **A Zoom change survives Restart now (Settings -> General).**
- **The setup wizard no longer dead-ends on a Chinese note type.**
- **Deck Filter reads a deck with the mining language's tokenizer.**
- **The first-visit deck checklist keeps its ticks when "Set up resources…" is chosen.**
- **The Usage Guide finds the language switcher by the language's own name (F1).**
- **Fewer wrong cards in English, German, Dutch, Danish, French, Spanish, Catalan, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian and Korean,** such as French `tu` and Danish `ikke`.
- **The Chinese language pack installs OpenCC on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14.**

name: v3.4.0
body:
### Added
- **Norwegian Bokmål, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Finnish, Croatian, Swedish, Polish, Lithuanian and Danish mining (Settings -> Mining Language).**
- **Dictionary-form card fronts for the new languages.** `boken` mines as `bok`, and a verb split from its particle or prefix mines whole.
- **Part-of-speech, gender, article and aspect fields for the new languages (Settings -> Cards & Anki).**
- **Wiktionary dictionaries and OpenSubtitles frequency lists for the new languages (Setup Wizard).**

### Changed
- **Character Set now sets the Chinese card front (Settings -> Filtering).** To keep traditional fronts, set Character Set to Traditional.
- **The Traditional card field uses Taiwan spelling (這裡, 麵條).**

### Fixed
- **Chinese known words match across simplified and traditional.**
- **Traditional Chinese subtitles split into the right words and read the right pinyin.**
- **A Chinese frequency list ranks words written in the other script.**
- **Folders on a USB or exFAT drive mined from macOS no longer fail on `._` files.**
- **Downloading a Whisper model or generating subtitles on macOS no longer opens a second copy of Anki Miner.**

name: v3.3.0
body:
### Added
- **English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Catalan mining (Settings -> Mining Language).**
- **Dictionary-form card fronts for the new languages.** `went` mines as `go`, and a split German or Dutch verb mines whole.
- **Part-of-speech, gender, article and plural fields for the new languages (Settings -> Cards & Anki).**
- **Wiktionary dictionaries and OpenSubtitles frequency lists for the new languages (Setup Wizard).**
- **Brazilian or European Portuguese (Settings -> Filtering -> Regional Variety).** Sets the Google voice and the suggested frequency list.
- **A deck checklist on the first switch to a language.** Ticked decks stay out of that language's known-words scan.
- **An SDH subtitle filter, on by default for the new languages.**
- **Known-words decks match fronts written with an article (`the dog`, `die Katze`, `l'homme`).**
- **Dialogue dash subtitle filter preset (Settings -> Filtering).**
- **Headerless `word count` frequency lists import (Settings -> Frequency).**
- **Importing a dictionary for a different language says so (Settings -> Dictionaries).**

### Changed
- **Video -> YouTube takes a pasted list of links,** one video or playlist per line.
- **The subtitle regex filter is kept per mining language (Settings -> Filtering).**
- **`pip install anki-miner[languages]` also installs spaCy.**
- **Korean and Chinese cards leave Sentence Furigana and Sentence Reading empty.**

### Fixed
- **Transcription no longer drops stretches of real speech (Utilities -> Generate, Utilities -> Audiobook Sync).**
- **Play in the Word Curator starts the line from its beginning again.**
- **Reinstalling mokuro on Windows no longer fails with "untrusted mount point".**
- **Google Translate and custom word audio work for Korean and Chinese cards.**
- **Korean EPUB paragraphs keep the space at a line wrap (Reading -> Novels).**

name: v3.2.0
body:
### Added
- **Edit a word's sentence, and which word to mine, in the Word Curator.**
- **Full sentences from split subtitle lines (Settings -> Filtering -> Full Sentences).** Off by default.
- **Audiobook Sync (Utilities -> Audiobook Sync).** Turns an audiobook and its `.epub` or `.txt` into an `.srt` of the book's own sentences.
- **The Word Curator says whether a word has pronunciation audio (Audio column).**
- **Manga OCR (Utilities -> Manga OCR).** Runs mokuro on a volume or series folder; install it from Settings -> Transcription & Alignment.
- **Secondary-language subtitles on Video -> Batch.** A Translation Folder picker and offset, paired by episode number like the subtitle folder.
- **Language pickers and playlist expansion (Utilities -> Download).**
- **macOS ships `AnkiMiner.app` in a `.dmg`.** Gatekeeper's Open Anyway clears the unsigned warning, so no Terminal command is needed.
- **Desktop icons and menu entries for the AppImage and the `.deb`.**
- **The Windows installer speaks seven of the app's twelve languages.**
- **One-click yt-dlp download where it is needed (Utilities -> Download, Video -> YouTube, Settings -> YouTube).**

### Changed
- **The Whisper transcription engine is an in-app download (Settings -> Transcription & Alignment).** Intel macOS gains local transcription for the first time.
- **Utilities -> Generate transcribes audio of any length.** A track past 6 h used to be refused.
- **The Linux and Windows downloads drop a duplicated copy of FFmpeg, about 54 MiB on Linux.**

### Removed
- **The bundled yt-dlp binary.** It downloads on first use instead.

### Fixed
- **Transcription works again on Apple Silicon Macs below macOS 14.**
- **The Word Curator previews the frame the card's screenshot will use.**
- **Frame steppers move the picture one frame at a time (Word Curator, subtitle viewer).**
- **The known-words scan reads the word field of a sentence-first note type** (Migaku, Core 2k/6k). Run Rebuild Known Words DB once.
- **Starting Anki after Anki Miner no longer strands a "could not load decks" message.**
- **A show past episode 999 pairs its videos and subtitles** (One Piece, Detective Conan).
- **A re-uploaded episode's version marker ("24 V2", "S01E02v5") no longer steals the episode slot.**
- **The dictionary-name line follows the note type again on Senren and Lapis cards.**
- **A note type's own tables and collapsible notes keep their styling inside the glossary.** Restyle both: Tools -> Restyle Mined Cards.
- **Warnings and banners name the step that actually failed.**
- **A partial run reports "Finished with errors", not "Failed".**
- **A cancelled scan or queue says cancelled, and keeps its counts.**
- **An install failure stays on one readable line (Settings),** with the original text in the tooltip.
- **Exception text, paths and config keys move behind Details.**
- **Settings copy, receipts and stale navigation paths corrected throughout.**
- **"Japanese" no longer appears where the mining language is configurable.**
- **Download probes are cancellable, and a probe whose URL changed is dropped.**
- **Batch translation folders follow the Secondary Subtitles setting.**
- **The Linux bundle no longer carries a copy of the Vulkan loader,** which risked shadowing your GPU driver.

name: v3.1.0
body:
### Added
- **A YouTube run picks where its subtitles come from (Video -> YouTube -> Subtitles).** Auto, Always transcribe, or Captions only.
- **Fetched captions can be retimed against the video's audio (Video -> YouTube -> Align captions to audio).**
- **Secondary-language subtitles (Video -> Single).** Off by default (Settings -> Filtering); the second track shows in the curator and fills a Translation field.
- **A whole folder condenses into one file (Utilities -> Condense).**
- **A run reports which whitelist words it did not mine.**
- **The screenshot frame is picked from the preview (Word Curator).** Not offered when animated screenshots are on.
- **Curator columns reorder, hide and persist between runs.**
- **Two sortable curator columns: unknowns on the word's line, and sentence length.**
- **K adds the highlighted rows to Known Words (Word Curator).**

### Changed
- **The log records what the app was doing.** Every record carries its thread and milliseconds; Export Diagnostics adds the on-disk config and state files.
- **Inline run options are remembered between launches.** Review words before mining, YouTube's caption source, Deck Builder's selection mode and Card Backfill's field groups.
- **A YouTube video with no captions is now transcribed instead of refused.** Choose Captions only for the previous behaviour.
- **macOS downloads carry the version (`AnkiMiner-3.1.0-macOS-arm64.tar.gz`).** Updating across this rename opens the release page instead of downloading directly.

### Fixed
- **A failed YouTube download names the reason instead of listing byte counts.** A deterministic failure no longer refetches the video.
- **A failing audio fetch names the word, and a failing YouTube fetch names the video.**
- **A transcription run no longer downloads a video before failing for a missing speech model.**
- **Korean 하다-predicates mine as their dictionary form (공부하고 -> 공부하다).**
- **A run that mines no words names the cause.** A subtitle in a language the run is not mining is called out.

name: v3.0.0
body:
### Added
- **Chinese and Korean mining (Settings -> Mining Language).** Switch language without a restart; each brings its own decks, dictionaries, filters and card fields.
- **Character Set for Chinese (Settings -> Mining Language),** Simplified or Traditional, on the card front and in the dictionary lookup.
- **Tone-coloured pinyin, a Measure Word field and a Traditional field on Chinese cards.**
- **A Hanja field and two script filters on Korean cards.**
- **Downloadable language packs (Settings -> Mining Language).** Frozen builds fetch the Chinese and Korean engines on demand.
- **KRDICT, a recommended Korean dictionary (Setup Wizard, and Settings -> Dictionaries).**
- **Cards can be created in order of appearance (Settings -> Filtering -> Card Order).** Off by default.
- **WebVTT (`.vtt`) subtitles mine and retime** alongside `.ass`, `.ssa` and `.srt`.

### Changed
- **Settings and Card Backfill show only what the active language has.** Pitch and furigana rows go under Chinese, Character Set under Japanese.
- **Known words, statistics and imported resources are kept per language.** Existing Japanese data keeps its path.
- **`pip install anki-miner[zh]` and `[ko]` add the engines, `[languages]` both.**
- **The Linux download is 45 MB smaller and the Windows one 20 MB.**
- **Downloaded subtitles arrive as `.srt` (Utilities -> Download),** so a subtitle-only download no longer needs ffmpeg.
- **Deck Filter's drop reason reads "not the mining language" (Utilities -> Deck Filter).**

### Fixed
- **Subtitles in Big5, GB18030 and CP949 decode as themselves.** GB18030 used to swallow a Big5 file into plausible-looking wrong characters.
- **Cards are created in the order media extraction was asked for.** Card order used to vary between runs of the same episode.
- **Fetching a word's audio no longer stalls a run.**
- **A slow audio pack is named, with its remedy.**
- **Importing an audio pack shows progress and can be cancelled (Settings -> Audio -> Add Audio Pack).**
- **A new online audio source goes above JPod101 (Settings -> Audio),** so it is actually consulted.
- **Message-box buttons no longer clip their labels.**
- **Subtitle generation reports transcription as soon as extraction finishes (Utilities -> Generate).**
- **A second subtitle-generation batch no longer stalls after a failed GPU attempt (Utilities -> Generate).**
- **A mining language this build cannot supply falls back to Japanese** instead of leaving no way back into Settings.
- **Settings search no longer offers a setting the active language hides.**
- **The Setup Wizard finishes for a language with no downloadable resources.**
- **A language switch repaints everything it changed.**

name: v2.14.0
body:
### Added
- **Word audio in Card Backfill (Utilities -> Card Backfill).** Cards you already mined get audio without re-mining.
- **Up to 1440p quality preset (Utilities -> Download).**

### Changed
- **Retiming writes `<name>_retimed.<ext>` and leaves the subtitle it read alone (Utilities -> Retime).** Mining and Condense pick the retimed file over the original.
- **The Card Backfill scan bar advances per note (Utilities -> Card Backfill).**

### Removed
- **`.pre-retime.bak` siblings (Utilities -> Retime).** Existing ones are ordinary subtitles and safe to delete.

### Fixed
- **A crashed resource import no longer blocks the next one for an hour.**
- **Card Backfill clears the old `9999999` frequency placeholder from cards no source ranks (Utilities -> Card Backfill).**
- **A greyed-out Card Backfill checkbox keeps its own tooltip.**

name: v2.13.0
body:
### Added
- **Standalone downloader (Utilities -> Download).** Saves video, audio or subtitles from any site yt-dlp supports, without mining them.
- **Merge an adjacent subtitle line into a word's sentence and clip (Word Curator) (#120).** The card sentence and the extracted media both follow.
- **YouTube auto-dubbed videos mine (Video -> YouTube).** A Japanese AI dub with machine-translated captions now counts as usable Japanese.

### Changed
- **The bundled yt-dlp is 2026.08.19.** The build 2.12.0 shipped returns "403: Forbidden" on every YouTube download since 17 August (#119).
- **Example sentences wrap at phrase boundaries (Word Curator -> Sentences).** Long book sentences break between phrases instead of mid-conjugation.
- **Startup, batch runs and dictionary lookups do far less repeat work.**

### Fixed
- **Closing a tab or the app after a run no longer crashes it or freezes the window.**
- **Retiming survives an ffsubsync that hangs, and Cancel stops it (Utilities -> Retime).**
- **Audio over six hours is refused instead of taking the app down (Utilities -> Generate).**
- **Yomitan redirect rows resolve to the entry they point at.** Roughly a third of Jitendex's rows carded as a bare arrow.
- **Duplicate checks survive a busy Anki instead of failing the run.**
- **An unreadable browser cookie database points at the app's own remedy (Settings -> YouTube).**
- **The Download tab shows a real percentage and stops fighting itself mid-run.**
- **Condense, Retime and Generate keep working after a folder that has gone missing.**
- **Line expansion no longer corrupts a card or locks "Reset lines" out (Word Curator).**
- **A vanished YouTube auto-dub fails once instead of retrying three times with the wrong error.**
- **Space plays and pauses anywhere in the curator's player pane.**
- **A second running copy of the app can no longer corrupt your settings file.**
- **Background tools no longer stop dead when the app is launched from a terminal.**
- **A corrupt page archive no longer strands the rest of a volume (Reading -> Manga).**

name: v2.12.0
body:
### Added
- **Pick one card image for pasted text (Reading -> Text).** One image is chosen once and shared by every card mined from that block of text.
- **Re-run a series the queue has already finished (Video -> Batch).** Selecting a completed series and running it mines it again without clearing the rest of the queue.
- **Take a Known Words mark back in the word curator.** "Add to Known Words" becomes "Remove from Known Words" once every selected row is already staged.
- **Reimport All and per-row Re-import for audio packs (Settings -> Audio).** Matches what dictionaries, frequency and pitch already had.
- **A dismiss button on the error banner.** Starting a run or a scan also clears whatever the previous attempt complained about.
- **Pre-release yt-dlp builds (Settings -> YouTube).** Points the in-app updater at yt-dlp's nightly repository, where extractor breakages are usually fixed days before a stable release. Off by default.

### Changed
- **Retiming no longer overwrites a usable subtitle with a worse one (Utilities -> Retime).** Four alignment candidates are tried in order and each is validated; when none passes, the input and output files are left exactly as they were and the outcome says why.
- **Retiming aligns on a dialogue-only copy of both files (Utilities -> Retime).** Signs, songs, HoH annotations and drawings are stripped before alignment and the winning timings are mapped back onto your untouched original, so every line and all ASS styling survive. An existing output file is copied to `<name>.pre-retime.bak` before it is overwritten.
- **Folder retiming lists the matched video and subtitle pairs, and the unmatched videos, as soon as both folders are chosen (Utilities -> Retime).** Mispairing was the silent destroyer of whole-season retimes.
- **An auto-picked embedded subtitle track has to cover the episode (Utilities -> Retime)**, which rejects the untitled signs and recap tracks that used to pass. The audio fallback says "first audio track (no Japanese tag)" rather than claiming it detected Japanese.
- **The word curator offers every example sentence a word appears on**, not the first twelve. The Sentences pane carries the number of options.
- **Yomitan dictionary imports are faster and their progress bar advances (Settings -> Add Dictionary).** The entries readout shows the real entry count once the import returns.
- **Mining stops when an audio pack needs re-importing.** A stale pack used to be dropped from the chain without a word, leaving cards with online audio or none at all. Re-import affected packs: Settings -> Audio -> Reimport All.

### Removed
- **The three retime alignment settings (Settings -> Transcription & Alignment).** "Split penalty", "Correct frame-rate differences" and "Shift by a single offset only" are gone; alignment tunes itself. "Shift by a single offset only" shipped on by default in 2.10.0 and was destroying cross-release retimes.

### Fixed
- **A word written as a verb stem but used as a noun is mined as the noun.** 差し入れ, ご存じ, お願い and お帰り no longer card as 差し入れる, 存じる, 願う and 帰る, so those words card once more under their new front.
- **A kana front gets the definition of the word actually used.** そうゆう, ゆった and どうゆう are spellings of 言う; the card back used to define "evening". The curator's definition pane follows the same scope.
- **A word no frequency source ranks leaves the sort field empty** instead of carrying 9999999, which read as a real rank on every card mined with a note type preset and no frequency list installed. Existing cards are repaired by a normal Card Backfill run.
- **A skipped file is reported as skipped (Utilities -> Generate, Retime, Condense).** A run in which everything was skipped names the remedy instead of finishing on "Complete - N files processed".
- **Condensing works on ffmpeg 9 (Utilities -> Condense)**, and refuses a system ffmpeg whose `aselect` filter passes every frame - Ubuntu ships one - instead of writing the whole source track out under a condensed file's name.
- **Folder pairing no longer depends on the order the filesystem happens to list videos in.** Applies to Batch, Deck Builder, Retime and Condense.
- **Accepting the startup "re-import these" prompt works.** It had been failing for every resource family, and its confirm button now names the action.
- **A resource scan overtaken by a newer one no longer strands the Settings panel** into refusing every change for the rest of the session.

name: v2.11.0
body:
### Added
- **Reimport All and per-row Re-import for frequency and pitch sources (Settings -> Frequency, Settings -> Pitch Accent).** Matches what dictionaries already had, and a row that is out of date is now distinguished from one whose folder is gone.
- **Several dictionary, frequency or pitch sources can be imported at once (Settings).** They import in order, and one file failing does not lose the ones that succeeded. (#114)
- **local-audio-yomichan `android.db` files register in place (Settings -> Audio -> Add Audio Pack).** Audio stays in the source database and is read on demand, so a multi-gigabyte database is not copied. (#115)

### Changed
- **Mining stops when a frequency or pitch source needs re-importing.** An out-of-date source used to be dropped from the chain without a word, leaving cards with no frequency rank or an empty pitch field. Re-import affected sources: Settings -> Frequency -> Reimport All.
- **An import started while another is still finishing waits its turn (Settings).** The "Another import is still finishing" refusal no longer appears.

### Fixed
- **A card whose Expression carries an invisible formatting character is recognised as a duplicate.** Cards made by Yomitan or asbplayer from Netflix subtitles can carry one, and re-mining the word made a second card.
- **Restore from Disk says when it finds nothing to add (Settings -> Audio, Frequency, Pitch Accent).** An empty result is the normal outcome once a source has gone out of date, and the message points at Reimport All.
- **System Health opens at a size that shows its rows, and its columns line up (Settings -> System Health).**

Thank you to @namidanokisetsu for #114 and #115 :).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.10.0...v2.11.0

name: v2.10.0
body:
### Added
- **Deck Filter (Utilities -> Deck Filter).** Copies the notes your filters keep from a premade deck into a new deck. Scan reports what would be kept and the drop reason for the rest; the source deck is not modified.
- **Season-level word review for batch mining (Video -> Batch).** "Review words before mining" opens the curator once per series instead of once per episode, with each word's candidates merged across the season. Off by default.
- **Metadata tags for condensed audio** (#113). "Tag output files" in Utilities -> Condense opens an editor pre-filled from each filename - title, album, artist, track number - plus genre and cover artwork. Writes to `mp3`, `opus` and `flac`. Off by default.
- **Per-word audio clip trimming in the word curator.** A slider under the video sets the clip bounds for the focused word; double-click restores the default.
- **Bundled ffmpeg, libmpv and both transcription backends in the Linux `.deb`**, matching the AppImage. The deb no longer depends on system ffmpeg.
- **Frequency Rank Range (Settings -> Filtering).** The frequency filter takes a minimum as well as a maximum. Either end can be left open.
- **Note type presets (Settings -> Anki).** Lapis, Kiku and Senren fill in every field mapping. The first-run wizard applies the matching preset when it recognises the note type.
- **"Include Words Missing from the Frequency List" (Settings -> Filtering).** Controls whether a word carrying no rank is mined. Off by default.
- **33 further entries in the Usage Guide**, including the menu-only tools: System Health, the setup wizard, session recovery and undoing a run.

### Changed
- **Retiming aligns against an embedded subtitle track where one exists (Utilities -> Retime)**, matching line to line; audio alignment is the fallback. The "Audio track:" row is now "Align against:".
- **Retiming's alignment knobs moved to Settings -> Transcription & Alignment** and now persist between launches. "Shift by a single offset only" is on by default; uncheck it to allow segmented alignment.
- **"Find a Feature" is renamed the Usage Guide** and moved to the menu bar, right of Tools. F1 unchanged.
- **"Treat Kana Spellings of Known Words as Known" moved** to the Script Type section of Settings -> Filtering.

### Removed
- **The "Strip subtitle annotations" setting (Settings -> Filtering).** Sound effects, speaker tags and inline furigana are now always stripped. The Subtitle regex filter remains available.
- **The "Skip katakana-stylized subtitle cues" setting (Settings -> Filtering).** Those cues are now always mined. A Subtitle regex filter entry replaces it.

### Fixed
- **The Japanese audio track is selected by its language tag** rather than by falling through to the first audio stream, and a commentary track no longer outranks the default Japanese one.
- **Stop takes effect during a card write** instead of after the batch completes, and a word whose only existing card sits in an excluded deck is no longer rejected as a duplicate of itself.
- **Undo no longer deletes a word mined by a later run.**
- **Card Backfill resolves each note against its own reading**, so it no longer falls through to a different-kanji spelling or writes an unrelated homograph's glossary. It also refuses to run against an out-of-date dictionary.
- **A frequency list labelled by raw counts is read as counts**, not ranks, so common words are no longer ranked as rare.
- **A missing source in a chain no longer drops the sources below it**, and a deleted source stays deleted after a restart.
- **A batch with failed items no longer reports success**, and a retry reports the cards that retry created rather than the lifetime total.
- **Cancelling interrupts a download or dictionary lookup in progress**, and closing a screen ends the work it started.
- **"Finish current" mines only the item in progress.**
- **A manga page with out-of-range text boxes no longer closes the app**, and two pages whose filenames match after normalisation no longer attach the wrong image to a card.
- **A malformed volume inside a folder is reported** instead of being skipped silently.
- **cp932 subtitles retime** instead of failing; this is the common encoding for Japanese subtitle downloads.
- **EUC-JP subtitles decode as Japanese** rather than Korean.
- **Condensing a folder no longer drops one of two files sharing a filename stem.**
- **Changing the file selectors mid-run no longer rewrites the finished result.**
- **Watch Later and other short playlist links expand as playlists**, and a download failure reports the underlying error rather than a routine warning.
- **Transcription on Auto tries the Vulkan engine before CPU** when CUDA cannot start.
- **Generate accepts an installed Vulkan model** as satisfying its pre-run check.
- **A failed transcription-model download keeps its error message on screen.**
- **Transcribing a queue loads the speech model once** rather than once per file.
- **The app no longer crashes during shutdown.**
- **Batch progress advances within a series**, not only at series boundaries, and a narrow window no longer clips a queue row's Edit and Remove buttons.
- **The word curator fits a 1024px screen.**
- **A spare space in the AnkiConnect URL is trimmed**, deck names refresh on every Add Deck, and Recheck rechecks the note type rather than opening documentation.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.9.3...v2.10.0

name: v2.9.3
body:
### Fixed
- **The word curator no longer takes the app down on Windows when a line plays (#112).** The video core was loading mpv's builtin Lua scripts, and the crash capture added in 2.9.2 treated their routine internal exceptions as fatal. `anki_miner.crash` now records only real crashes.
- **The kana exclusions skip the words they promise.** Long-vowel spellings (すごーい, ずーっと) and katakana stems with hiragana okurigana (サボる, ヤバい) slipped past both switches. Tick both boxes for a kanji-only deck; either one alone still mines the mixed-kana loanwords.

### Removed
- **The word curator's video-preview switch**, and the crash marker that turned it off by itself. The abort it guarded was a packaging fault, fixed at the source in 2.9.2. `ANKI_MINER_NO_VIDEO_PREVIEW=1` still turns the preview off.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.9.2...v2.9.3

name: v2.9.2
body:
### Added
- **A switch for the word curator's video preview (Settings -> Interface).** Turn it off and the audio and sentence still work; only the picture goes.
- **The preview turns itself off after it kills the app.** The next launch disables it, says why, and links to the setting.
- **Crashes reach the log.** A hard process death is recorded and folded into the log at the next start, so a bug report carries it.

### Changed
- **Yomitan zips with a wrong recorded CRC-32 now import** - dictionaries, frequency lists and pitch sources alike. Truncated or malformed archives still fail.

### Fixed
- **The word curator no longer takes the app down with it** on machines whose graphics driver fails to load.
- **The Linux build no longer aborts on newer systems**, and the fix now reaches `.deb` users, who were silently missing it.
- **Cards get the right word, reading and definition more often.** Homograph mix-ups, ignored reading overrides, wrongly folded long vowels, truncated deinflection and misclassified compounds.
- **Subtitle text survives to the card intact.** Dialogue containing `<`, `>` or braces is no longer deleted as markup, HTML entities are decoded, and a replaced subtitle is re-parsed instead of served from cache.
- **Filtering counts what you asked it to.** Occurrence counts, the definition check and i+1 sentence choice now run in the right order, and difficulty statistics stop merging distinct words.
- **Reading sources survive malformed input.** Broken and DRM-protected EPUBs report properly, Aozora headers survive leading blank lines, and Mokuro sidecars are found regardless of filename case.
- **Episode pairing picks the right file.** `Ep` no longer matches inside words like "Steps", two-part episode numbers are kept, and ASS beats SSA beats SRT.
- **A field mapping that would break the card is refused** instead of accepted.
- **Furigana no longer stalls on an ambiguous reading.**


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.9.1...v2.9.2

name: v2.9.1
body:
### Added
- **Export Diagnostics (Help menu, System Health footer).** One click writes a zip with your log and its rotations, an environment snapshot, the health report and your settings.
- **Card Backfill checks your note type before it scans.** A missing note type or Expression field says so instead of returning an empty plan, and a field that does not exist is named while its siblings still fill.
- **A kana spelling of a word you already have counts as known.** うなずく no longer makes a second card when 頷く is in your collection. On by default; Settings -> Filtering.
- **`ANKI_MINER_LOG_LEVEL`** turns up the log level for a run you are reproducing.

### Changed
- **The log records more information for debugging.**
- **The log holds a whole run**, at 8MB instead of 2MB, so a full batch no longer overwrites its own session header.
- **ASR backend selection and fallback are visible.** A Vulkan failure dropping every transcription to CPU used to leave no trace.
- **Failures that were swallowed now report** - an installed Vulkan pack read as missing, a scan that never started, corrupt dictionary metadata dropping a source from the chain.
- **Settings Profiles moved into the settings footer.**
- **Interface translations back to 100%** across all 11 languages.

### Fixed
- **Card Backfill no longer says your notes "already have values" when it matched nothing**, sending you hunting through a collection it never looked at. It names the scope that came back empty instead.
- **Card Backfill stops throwing away the Anki error.** A failed deck fetch silently fell back to "All decks".
- **Per-word media extraction failures reach the log**, which is what the on-screen message had been promising.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.9.0...v2.9.1

name: v2.9.0
body:
### Added
- **Pick a theme by looking at it (Settings -> Appearance).** A grid of live previews instead of a list of names, so all 29 themes are visible before you choose. First-run setup opens on a theme step.
- **Multiple pitch accent sources (Settings -> Pitch Accent).** An ordered chain of pitch dictionaries, like frequency. First hit wins, so lower sources extend coverage rather than overwrite it. An existing `pitch_accent.csv` folds into the chain on first launch.
- **Named settings profiles.** Switch configurations from the window header; create, rename, duplicate and delete them in the manager dialog. Useful for a setup per show, per deck, or per source language.
- **A pinned run action and Activity drawer on every workflow screen.** The run button no longer scrolls out of reach, and `Ctrl+Enter` starts the run from anywhere on the screen.
- **Runs end in an inline receipt** written into the page: what was mined, what was skipped and why, how many cards were created. A cancelled run reports the work it did complete.
- **Find a setting by name (Settings).** A search box jumps straight to the page holding it, and the pages are grouped into a side navigator.
- **System Health (Settings -> System Health).** The state of Anki, ffmpeg, yt-dlp, dictionaries and models in one place, with a Fix link per row.
- **The app reopens where you left it:** same size, position, screen and tab. File pickers reopen in the folder you last accepted.
- **Queues survive a crash.** A session that ended abnormally offers one Restore or Discard choice for the queue and any partial downloads.
- **The word curator is a normal window, not a modal.** The rest of the app stays usable while it is open, and words added to Known Words are staged until you press Confirm.
- **Automatic retry for queue items** that fail a transient step, bounded and cancellable.
- **Reset Statistics (Analytics).**
- **A read-only mini job monitor**, reachable from anywhere, showing what is running now.
- **A filterable activity log console**, with level filters instead of a scrolling text box.

### Changed
- **Interface translations refreshed** across all 11 languages.
- **The Activity drawer no longer opens itself.** It opened on nearly every run and took 40% of the page. Problems still reach you through the receipt and the on-screen banner.
- **File pickers use your system's own dialog again**, and no longer freeze the app (#100).
- **The Settings pages are called Filtering and Audio again.**
- **An empty queue no longer reserves six rows of nothing.**
- **A failed condense says why**, carrying ffmpeg's own last line.
- **Every screen has one content width.** Page widths used to vary by hundreds of pixels between tabs.
- **The accent colour is spent only on priority, state and focus**, so a screen has one primary action instead of several competing ones. Lists, tables and trees share one selection and hover treatment.
- **Failures report on the screen they happened on.** No recoverable failure opens a modal any more.
- **Progress and Cancel are honest.** Progress names the stage it is in and counts finished items instead of guessing. Cancel is one verb that becomes a disabled "Cancelling…" while the worker stops.
- **Themes reach the whole interface**, including the widgets the stylesheet used to miss. A theme with too little contrast is flagged rather than silently corrected.
- **The interface and fixed-width faces come from your platform**, and Japanese is styled as content rather than as interface chrome.
- **The recommended-resource download runs in the background** instead of holding a modal open.
- **yt-dlp now ships with the app.** A yt-dlp on your PATH still takes priority, since it is usually newer.
- **UI text size applies on the next launch**, and says so.
- **Every mining dialog is IME-safe**, and keyboard focus draws a visible ring with a predictable tab order.

### Removed
- **The Pitch Accent File picker (Settings -> Dictionaries)**, replaced by the Pitch Accent tab.
- **The four separate chain editors**, replaced by one priority list shared by dictionaries, audio, frequency and pitch.
- **The results dialog that opened per finished item**, replaced by the run receipt.

### Fixed
- **Condensing an ordinary episode failed in every release build.** Anything past roughly 125 kept periods, i.e. a routine 25-minute episode.
- **Subtitle spacing survives into furigana** instead of being re-spaced by rule.
- **A word's reading is checked against the dictionary before it reaches the card** (鉢 shipped as ばち where only はち is attested). An ambiguous word keeps its reading and is flagged for review rather than guessed at.
- **Deinflection picks the word the sentence used.** The adverb 決まって used to beat the verb 決まる and become a card front.
- **Names split across kanji are recognised again** (夏油, 狗巻), so the proper-noun filter and name list stop seeing fragments.
- **The same word no longer makes two cards under two spellings** (よそ見/余所見, 肉じゃが/肉ジャガ).
- **Kanjium pitch patterns were read out of the wrong columns**, so some cards carried a pattern contradicting the source.
- **A word with more than one pitch pattern reads as a numbered list** instead of fusing its contours together.
- **Cards no longer show a bare "1 2 3" before the definition.**
- **Yomitan glossaries keep their row structure** instead of being flattened.
- **Reimport All no longer reports your whole dictionary chain as missing its source.**
- **The main window fits the screen it is on.** At 150% scaling its minimum could exceed the work area, so restoring from maximised filled the screen and the borders stopped dragging.
- **The word curator opens at a usable size**, no longer taller than the display with Confirm under the taskbar, and its definition pane is styled like the card.
- **Known words are matched however they are spelled**, so a word you marked known is no longer re-carded, and an import counts the rows it actually writes.
- **Removing a pitch source keeps it removed** instead of re-importing on the next launch.
- **Card Backfill never writes pitch from a guessed reading**, leaving your existing pitch untouched when no reading field is mapped.
- **The activity log stops reporting normal conditions as crashes.** Anki not running, a cancelled import, or a missing optional tool no longer print tracebacks.
- **Picking a different example sentence updates the whole row** in the word curator (#108), and **Copy word copies the word it shows** rather than unidic's lemma (#107).
- **The yt-dlp installer never worked**, and bundled builds shipped no yt-dlp binary at all.
- **macOS: the bundled yt-dlp would not start**, so YouTube mining worked only with your own yt-dlp installed.
- **YouTube videos with Japanese auto-captions were reported as having none**, and a missing subtitle downloaded the video twice.
- **The Settings navigator cut off its own destination names.**
- **The Backfill preview and Analytics tables showed under one row of data** (#102).
- **A thin dark line under every tab bar**, and a box drawn around a Settings destination when you clicked it.
- **The pitch accent overline ran across the whole word on some note types** (Senren and anything else that draws every mora line). Newly mined cards are correct; to fix existing ones, run Utilities -> Card Backfill with overwrite on the pitch field.
- **Word audio was skipped for words whose reading is not kana**, in JPod101, Google TTS and local audio packs.
- **The deck and note type Refresh buttons were invisible**, and a missing deck was reported as a warning rather than an error.
- **Square glyph buttons clipped their glyph.**


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.8.4...v2.9.0

name: v2.8.4
body:
### Added
- **Repair a broken dictionary in place (Settings -> Dictionaries).** Re-import a corrupt or metadata-less slot from its source without a full reset; startup also reconciles slots left by an earlier crash.
- **Reset all settings to defaults (Settings).** (#99)

### Changed
- **The recommended dictionary is now JMdict (Yomitan build), not Jitendex.** Existing Jitendex installs are untouched.
- **Windows install, upgrade, and uninstall are hardened.** Upgrading keeps your data, downgrades are blocked with a clear message, and config migrates forward.
- **First-run setup is more robust.** Creates the default dictionary folder at startup, fails fast when no usable offline dictionary is present, retries transient downloads, and defaults file pickers to non-native dialogs.
- **Reliability and performance hardening across the app.**

### Fixed
- **Clean-install freeze when opening a file dialog (#100).** Non-native dialogs by default, with a toggle.
- **A second app instance now warns instead of disrupting the running one.**
- **Runs never report success on a failure or cancel.**
- **Dictionary imports degrade gracefully instead of aborting on one bad entry.**
- **Read-only dictionary access works on Windows extended-length paths.**

name: v2.8.3
body:
### Added
- **Paste text straight into the Reading tab to mine it (Reading -> Text).** No file needed; synthetic sentence TTS still applies if enabled.
- **Backfill missing fields on cards you already made (Tools -> Card Backfill).** Scan a deck, preview what would be filled (pitch/frequency/definition/glossary/reading), then Apply. Fills only empty fields by default.
- **Mine a whole folder of books at once (Reading -> Novels).**
- **Bulk-import a known-word list from another tool (Manage Known Words -> Import…).** Format auto-detected.
- **Strip subtitle annotations before mining (Settings -> Filtering).** Removes SFX tags, speaker labels, and inline furigana. On by default.

### Changed
- **Far fewer junk cards, with more accurate readings.** A large parsing overhaul: name word sets default on, tokenizer garbage rejected, stylized spellings folded to standard headwords, dictionary-attested compounds, dictionary-form card fronts, curated reading fixes.
- **Card styling moved to per-field style blocks.** Fixes mined glossaries flattening or losing styling on Lapis- and Kiku-class note types. Run Tools -> Restyle Mined Cards to migrate existing cards.
- **Faster batch and queue runs.** Batched frequency lookups and shared lookup services; fixed a memory climb from word sets.

### Fixed
- **Windows: the bundled video preview now works on machines without a Vulkan driver.** Release builds ship `vulkan-1.dll` next to libmpv.
- **The top menu bar is readable in dark mode.**
- **Definitions match the exact spelling on the card.**
- **Pitch accent lines up with the resolved card front.**
- **The word curator copies the sentence you selected** (#95).
- **Guarded against oversized or malformed images, EPUBs, and .mokuro files.**


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.8.2...v2.8.3

name: v2.8.2
body:
### Added
- **Remove/Clear subtitle-file queue rows mid-run (Reading -> Subtitles).**

### Changed
- **Video preview now runs on embedded mpv (libmpv).** Allows AV1 to decode on all devices cleanly, no more hardware decoding restrictions.

### Removed
- **Migration paths for very old versions.** 

### Fixed
- **Frequency dictionaries no longer give rare kanji spellings the base word's kana rank.** Re-import affected sources: Settings -> Frequency -> right-click -> Re-import.
- **Cancelling a dictionary/audio-pack import no longer shows a false "Import Failed".**
- **Captions no longer clip in tight layouts** (Batch tab Quick Processing card, file-selector status lines).



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.8.1...v2.8.2

name: v2.8.1
body:
### Added

- **Audio Condenser (Tools -> Condense).** Turn a video/audio file plus its subtitles into condensed dialogue-only audio (`mp3`/`opus`/`flac`), with optional re-timed `.srt`+`.lrc`.
- **Subtitle-only mining (Reading -> Subtitles).**
- **TTS sentence audio for Reading cards (Settings -> Audio).** Manga, novel, and subtitle-file cards can get synthesized sentence audio (Google TTS, Papago fallback).
- **Definitions in Reading curation.** The word curator for manga/novels/subtitles now shows the dictionary pane, like video mining.
- **Export / import settings.** Two buttons at the bottom of Settings; the export strips machine-specific state so it works on another computer.
- **Constant subtitle offset for Batch Quick Processing.** One offset applied to every episode in the folder.

### Changed

- **Tabs reorganised** Single Episode, Batch, and YouTube now under **Video** tab.Subtitles tab renamed to **Tools** to allow for other tools. 
- **Settings save themselves.** Edits commit automatically ~1s after you stop typing; the Save button and Ctrl+S are gone. Invalid values keep their previous setting with an inline note instead of a blocking dialog.
- **Cards carry less CSS.** (#93) The embedded stylesheet is tailored to each card (~2 KB instead of ~9 KB for most). Run Tools -> Restyle Mined Cards once to shrink existing Anki Miner cards.

### Removed

- **Preview buttons.** 
- **"Reset to Defaults" button.**

### Fixed

- **Compound words' readings improved.**
- **Cleaner mined sentences.** TV-caption arrows (➡), speaker emoji, and tofu are stripped.
- **Exact frequency ranks.** A float rounding bug made some cards sort one rank below the number they displayed.
- **Kanji-variant spellings get their own definition and frequency.** 
- **A folder name ending in a space no longer crashes mining.**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1

name: v2.8.0
body:
### Added

- **Reading tab**: Mine manga and novels.
  - **Manga**: Point at a mokuro-processed folder (single volume or multiple) and mine manga, with panels in the Picture field.
  - **Novels**: Mine `.epub` or `.txt` files one at a time; each card carries the book's cover in the Picture field.


### Removed

- **Custom CSS field removed.** Card styling now comes from each dictionary's own styling + Anki Miner CSS. 

### Fixed

- **Progress bar no longer shows stale labels.** Progress rows in the Reading, YouTube, and Audiobook queues no longer keep the previous step's name stuck to the current status.
- **Potential-form verbs no longer make duplicate cards.** Forms like 保てる or 見れる now share the base verb's card (保つ, 見る) instead of mining a second one.
- **More words get frequency and pitch data.** Some loanwords and pronouns were missing it.
- **Multi-word dictionary tags show as one label again.** Jitendex tags like "priority form" were breaking into a garbled list on some cards; they stay intact now. Dictionaries re-import once on the next launch.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.7.8...v2.8.0

name: v2.7.8
body:
### Added

- **Definitions for spelling variants and inflected input.** Lookup falls back through source spelling (乞う/請う), kana variants, and deinflection - so variant-spelling dictionaries hit and inflected input (食べさせられた -> 食べる) resolves.
- **Restyle older cards.** Tools -> Restyle Mined Cards embeds the glossary stylesheet into cards mined before v2.7.8 so they render like new ones - no re-mining. Safe to re-run; touches only Anki Miner's own cards.
- **Hand-edited field mappings survive a Settings save.** Saving no longer wipes `anki_fields` keys the panel doesn't know about.
- **Word audio from any URL or a local audio server.** New Settings -> Audio source kinds: a custom URL template and custom-JSON (the local-audio-yomichan contract). Free, keyless; sources chain by priority.
- **Occurrence-count frequency lists import correctly.** Occurrence-based zips (previously rejected) and occurrence CSVs (which inverted the Max-frequency-rank filter) now convert to ranks at import.
- **Word-based (categorical) frequency lists work.** Level-label lists (N5, Basic, 初級) - which used to crash the import or mis-rank - are detected, badged "word-based", and their label renders on the card without entering rank filtering or sorting.
- **Pitch accent as a graph or overline (opt-in).** Two new mappable fields: PitchGraph (OJAD-style graph) and PitchText (per-mora overline + downstep). Self-contained, dark-mode aware. Unmapped by default.
- **Dictionary imports report skipped entries.** Malformed entries are counted in the import dialog instead of vanishing, and a zip nested one folder too deep gives a precise error - for definition, frequency, and pitch zips.
- **Word audio "not found" markers heal themselves.** JPod101 negative markers expire after 180 days; Settings -> Audio -> "Retry missing word audio" clears them on demand.
- **Dictionary tags render as labeled chips.** Tag metadata (parts of speech, usage notes, popularity) shows as hover-labeled chips instead of a comma list. Re-import to pick up.
- **Re-import prompt after a format upgrade.** A stale on-disk index - which used to silently produce zero cards - is caught on startup with one-click "Reimport All", and mining refuses to start until you do. Frequency indexes unaffected.
- **More audio-pack formats import.** Add Audio Pack now handles ozk5 alongside AJT, NHK16, Forvo, and JPod; NHK16 packs drop unused spellings and expand counter subentries. Re-import to pick up.

### Changed

- **Definitions lead with the reading-matched sense.** For a homograph (辛い からい/つらい), the sense matching the sentence's reading sorts first - a boost, not a filter. Shared-reading entries (橋/箸) render as separate blocks; duplicates collapse. Re-mine to refresh.
- **Media clips no longer collide across episodes.** Filenames carry a content hash, so different clips for the same word and timestamp in different files don't overwrite each other.
- **Duplicates detected before submitting; real errors surface.** Batches are pre-checked, so duplicate counts are exact and a genuinely broken note shows as an error instead of a silent "duplicate". Deck Builder re-runs skip existing cards.
- **Frequency data is reading-aware and shows the author's display values.** Homographs (方 かた/ほう) look up frequency under their in-sentence reading, and dictionaries with display strings (JPDB "1099/72000", ㋕) render them. Re-import to gain display values.
- **Dictionary images render correctly on dark note types.** Monochrome SVGs recolor to the text color; pixel-art stays crisp. Newly imported/reimported dictionaries.
- **Anki Miner no longer writes to your note type's card styling.** Glossary CSS is embedded per card. A leftover "ANKI MINER DICT STYLES" block is overridden and can be removed from the note type.
- **The run summary names the likely cause of missing word audio.** A widespread failure (outage, expired certificate, rate-limiting) is named so you know it's transient. Scattered failures stay quiet.
- **Frequency sort uses a harmonic mean and sorts unranked words last.** So one niche list can't dominate the sort. The Max-frequency-rank filter is unchanged. Re-mine to refresh.
- **Subtitle text is normalized before tokenization.** Halfwidth katakana (ﾊﾟｿｺﾝ -> パソコン), NFD kana, compatibility ligatures (㍿ -> 株式会社), Kangxi radicals (⼭ -> 山), and 𠮟 normalize before MeCab, so words that used to skip as unknowns now mine.
- **Furigana is distributed per kanji.** 入り口 -> 入[い]り 口[ぐち]; genuinely ambiguous words (飼い犬) keep one whole-word reading. Affects ExpressionFurigana and SentenceFurigana; re-mine to refresh.

### Fixed

- **Dictionaries with their own styling render as intended.** For a dictionary that ships its own `styles.css` (Jitendex, NHK), the built-in glossary hooks no longer apply on top - fixing Jitendex example sentences that rendered tiny and grey. Dictionaries without their own styles keep the built-in look; Restyle Mined Cards fixes pre-v2.7.8 cards too.
- **Mined-card glossary styling is self-contained again.** Styling travels inside every card, so cards render correctly on any note type, on AnkiDroid, and when exported - the v2.7.6 rework left them bare.
- **Typed glossary entries no longer render as empty text.** Term-bank-v3 typed entries (text/image) previously fell through to an empty span; both now render. Re-mine to refresh.
- **Dictionary cross-reference links no longer dead-end on cards.** A Yomitan-internal `?query=…` link becomes a no-op anchor; external http(s) links are unaffected.
- **Context-dependent noun readings match the sentence.** A word reading more than one way (方 かた/ほう) keeps its in-sentence reading on the card, in pitch lookup, and in word audio. The first run after upgrading re-fetches word audio once for affected nouns.
- **Accented verbs and adjectives are now categorized 起伏 (kifuku).** 食べる[2] is kifuku, not the mislabeled 中高. Affects PitchCategory; re-mine to refresh.
- **Pitch accent matches the word's reading.** A homograph (弾く ひく[0] vs はじく[2]) gets the pattern for its in-sentence reading, and imported Yomitan pitch dictionaries keep their `[HL]` patterns and nasal/devoice annotations. Re-import the pitch zip once.

### Repo
- 50 stars!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.7.7...v2.7.8

name: v2.7.7
body:
### Added
- **Vulkan GPU transcription.** Subtitles -> Generate can transcribe on AMD and Intel GPUs, alongside NVIDIA CUDA. Pick "Vulkan" as the device and download the Vulkan model. Bundled app builds only; the PyPI install stays CPU-only.
- **Whole words instead of fragments.** 走り出した now mines 走り出す instead of 走り, 応急処置 stays one card, and 気がした mines 気がする. Words and expressions are matched against your offline dictionaries, longest match first.
- **Seven new UI languages.** German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Indonesian, and Vietnamese, selectable in Settings (restart to apply).

### Changed
- **Glossary styling is now one consistent stylesheet**, applied automatically on Save.
- **Subtitles panel reorganized.** Transcription downloads are grouped under "Transcription add-ons (optional)" with a short description each.

### Fixed
- **Cleaner transcripts.** A short line no longer stretches across minutes of silence, and hallucinated non-speech lines are dropped.
- **Windows GUI no longer freezes when closing the preview** (Win11).
- **alass shows "Installed" when bundled or on PATH**, not only when downloaded in-app.
- **No more duplicate subtitle files on Windows.**
- **Animated screenshots fall back to WebP when AVIF isn't available** (notably the Intel macOS build), instead of silently dropping every word.
- **Some dictionaries no longer lose styling** - Jitendex's form-priority icons and table borders render again (#89).
- **AV1 preview "can't decode" notice no longer false-fires on capable hardware** (#82). Mining is unaffected either way.
- **Furigana keeps okurigana outside the reading** - 終[しま]い, not 終い[しまい].
- **Quick Processing updates both progress bars** during folder runs.
- **Closing Settings while it's still loading no longer errors.**
- **Glossary sense items no longer pick up your note type's bullet styling.**
- **Glossary styling no longer forces an Anki sync on every launch.**
- **Mined verbs and adjectives keep the spelling used in the subtitle** - 乞う no longer becomes 請う.
- **Sentence bold now covers the whole conjugated word** - 蒔いた, not 蒔い.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.7.5...v2.7.7

name: v2.7.5
body:
### Added
- **Subtitle generation.** Subtitles -> Generate transcribes video or audio into an SRT with a local Whisper model. Model, GPU (CUDA) pack, and voice-activity pack install in-app; device selector falls back to CPU.
- **Subtitle retiming.** Subtitles -> Retime realigns an out-of-sync subtitle file to your video with alass, installed in-app.
- **Multiple frequency sources.** Settings -> Frequency takes a chain of frequency lists, each in its own index, with a `frequency_sort` field. An existing `frequency.csv` migrates in once on first launch.
- **Find a Feature browser.** Tools -> Find a Feature searches the app's capabilities and jumps to the relevant tab or setting.
- **Spanish, French, and Russian UI.** Selectable in Settings (restart to apply).
- **Per-dictionary card styling** (#87). Imported dictionaries render with their own `styles.css` (like with Yomitan), with a fallback for those that ship none.
- **Whole-UI Zoom.** Scales the interface via `QT_SCALE_FACTOR`.
- **Card-type fields added**: IsWordAndSentenceCard and others, based off Lapis note type.
- **Word list sorted by occurrence** (#88) in the curation dialog.
- **Intel macOS build.** Releases include an `x86_64` macOS bundle; the update check points Intel users at it.

### Changed
- **ASR folded into the Subtitles panel** with the alass, model, and pack installs.
- **Audiobook tab renamed Audio.** Audio mining was never audiobook-only, made this clearer.
- **Recommended frequency resources import into the chain** instead of a standalone file.

### Fixed
- **Further fixes for GUI crashes**.
- **Dictionary styling fixes** (#87). Muted-text opacity no longer cascades; a ReDoS in the `styles.css` scan was removed.
- **Sibling subtitles match case-insensitively** when auto-filling the subtitle selector.

### Removed
- Dead internals: `FrequencyService`, the single-CSV frequency importer, unused `_AsrState` fields.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xzerolight/anki_miner/compare/v2.7.4...v2.7.5
